summary: Enforce project-owned report and operational evidence placement

delivery.outcome: Enforce declared project deliverable destinations and pinned Docs preparation/completion through Wellman, with project-owned operational evidence and real worktree identity. Publish through the independent protected route.
nonGoals: No arbitrary-shell filesystem sandbox claims, protected policy writes, private-log publication or silent relocation/deletion of foreign data.
Do not replace pinned Docs/Report/Logs contracts with guessed placement rules.

architecture.decision: Wire the pinned Docs checker at explicit preparation and completion boundaries, validate owner/worktree and paths before Wellman-owned artifact writes, reject unsafe or external destinations and distinguish document delivery from private receipts. Retain per-standard evidence semantics.
interfaceChanges: Explicit artifact preparation/completion; declared deliverables checked by aggregate check.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material implementation through protected publication; preserve all original evidence hashes.
